sentences.hanzi: 中秋节快到了，小明和丽丽都很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì dōu hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival was approaching, and Xiaoming and Lili were both very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“我们一起来做月饼吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: "Wǒmen yīqǐ lái zuò yuèbǐng ba."
sentences.english: Dad said, "Let's make mooncakes together."

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我来帮你，爸爸。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ lái bāng nǐ, bàba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I'll help you, Dad."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我也来帮忙，我可以做兔子灯笼。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yě lái bāngmáng, wǒ kěyǐ zuò tùzi dēnglóng."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I'll help too. I can make a rabbit lantern."

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈拿出面粉、糖和鸡蛋。
sentences.pinyin: Māma ná chū miànfěn, táng hé jīdàn.
sentences.english: Mom took out flour, sugar, and eggs.

sentences.hanzi: 小明洗手后，和爸爸一起做月饼。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng xǐshǒu hòu, hé bàba yīqǐ zuò yuèbǐng.
sentences.english: After washing his hands, Xiaoming made mooncakes with Dad.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽拿来彩纸，做了一只白色的兔子灯笼。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì ná lái cǎizhǐ, zuò le yī zhī báisè de tùzi dēnglóng.
sentences.english: Lili brought colored paper and made a white rabbit lantern.

sentences.hanzi: 兔子灯笼很漂亮，丽丽很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Tùzi dēnglóng hěn piàoliang, Lìlì hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: The rabbit lantern was very beautiful, and Lili was very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 晚上，月亮又大又圆。
sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshang, yuèliang yòu dà yòu yuán.
sentences.english: That evening, the moon was big and round.

sentences.hanzi: 一家人坐在外面，吃月饼，看月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Yī jiā rén zuò zài wàimiàn, chī yuèbǐng, kàn yuèliang.
sentences.english: The whole family sat outside, eating mooncakes and looking at the moon.

sentences.hanzi: 小明问：“妈妈，为什么中秋节的月亮这么圆？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: "Māma, wèishénme Zhōngqiūjié de yuèliang zhème yuán?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, "Mom, why is the moon so round at the Mid-Autumn Festival?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈说：“因为中秋节是团圆的日子。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma shuō: "Yīnwèi Zhōngqiūjié shì tuányuán de rìzi."
sentences.english: Mom said, "Because the Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunion."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“奶奶，您给我们讲嫦娥的故事吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Nǎinai, nín gěi wǒmen jiǎng Cháng'é de gùshi ba."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Grandma, please tell us the story of Chang'e."

sentences.hanzi: 奶奶笑着说：“好，我来讲。”
sentences.pinyin: Nǎinai xiào zhe shuō: "Hǎo, wǒ lái jiǎng."
sentences.english: Grandma said with a smile, "Alright, I'll tell it."

sentences.hanzi: 很久以前，天上有十个太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, tiānshàng yǒu shí gè tàiyáng.
sentences.english: Long ago, there were ten suns in the sky.

sentences.hanzi: 人们生活得很辛苦。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen shēnghuó de hěn xīnkǔ.
sentences.english: People lived very hard lives.

sentences.hanzi: 一个叫后羿的人，用弓箭射下了九个太阳。
sentences.pinyin: Yī gè jiào Hòuyì de rén, yòng gōngjiàn shè xià le jiǔ gè tàiyáng.
sentences.english: A man named Houyi used his bow and arrows to shoot down nine of the suns.

sentences.hanzi: 他得到了一颗特别的药。
sentences.pinyin: Tā dédào le yī kē tèbié de yào.
sentences.english: He obtained a special medicine.

sentences.hanzi: 有一天，后羿的妻子嫦娥吃了那颗药。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yī tiān, Hòuyì de qīzi Cháng'é chī le nà kē yào.
sentences.english: One day, Houyi's wife Chang'e ate that medicine.

sentences.hanzi: 她飞到了月亮上。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fēi dào le yuèliang shàng.
sentences.english: She flew to the moon.

sentences.hanzi: 后羿很想念她。
sentences.pinyin: Hòuyì hěn xiǎngniàn tā.
sentences.english: Houyi missed her very much.

sentences.hanzi: 每年的八月十五，他都会看着月亮。
sentences.pinyin: Měi nián de bā yuè shíwǔ, tā dōu huì kàn zhe yuèliang.
sentences.english: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month every year, he would look at the moon.

sentences.hanzi: 从此，人们在中秋节赏月、吃月饼，想念家人。
sentences.pinyin: Cóngcǐ, rénmen zài Zhōngqiūjié shǎngyuè, chī yuèbǐng, xiǎngniàn jiārén.
sentences.english: From then on, people admired the moon, ate mooncakes, and missed their families at the Mid-Autumn Festival.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“嫦娥一个人在月亮上，会想家吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Cháng'é yī gè rén zài yuèliang shàng, huì xiǎng jiā ma?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Chang'e is alone on the moon. Will she miss home?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“她一定很想家，所以我们一家人要在一起。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Tā yīdìng hěn xiǎng jiā, suǒyǐ wǒmen yī jiā rén yào zài yīqǐ."
sentences.english: Lili said, "She must miss home very much, so our family should stay together."

sentences.hanzi: 大家都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiào le.
sentences.english: Everyone laughed.

sentences.hanzi: 这个中秋节，小明和丽丽过得非常开心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège Zhōngqiūjié, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì guò de fēicháng kāixīn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili had a very happy Mid-Autumn Festival.
